All variables used are straightforward and refer to expected build-time values. The source URL points to the declared upstream GitHub repository, and the commit hash and checksum are pinned. Even if the checksum were marked as 'SKIP' (which it is not), that would not affect safety during `--printsrcinfo`. No evidence of obfuscation, data exfiltration, or remote code execution exists in the global scope.
</details>
